statement.zh: **标准**：密码模块安全要求（Security requirements for cryptographic modules）。
statement.en: **Standard**: Security requirements for cryptographic modules (密码模块安全要求).The positioning fact this entry can attest is printed in §1 of FIPS 140-3: "FIPS 140-3 supersedes FIPS140-2.

statement.zh: 为什么要同时有一国际标准：前部句子把关系说清之后，同一份文件继续规定测试路径——要求「The testing for these requirements will be in accordance with ISO/IEC 24759:2017(E)」式的双文件结构，即安全要求由 19790 系给出、如何测由 24759 给出。对齐使同一套模块要求可以进入国际互认，而不必让各国各自维护一套不可比的判据。
statement.en: Why an international edition exists is implied by the division of labour the same section prints: "The testing for these requirements will be in accordance with ISO/IEC 24759:2017(E)" - requirements come from the 19790 line and the testing procedure from ISO/IEC 24759, with the permitted modifications stated alongside.Alignment lets one set of module requirements enter international recognition instead of each jurisdiction maintaining incomparable criteria.

statement.zh: 使用它时的判定条件写在安全等级的句子里（留存件把它排在 §7 附近的等级讨论中）：「must be chosen to provide a level of security appropriate for the security requirements of the application and environment」也即等级不是越高越好，而是与部署环境的要求相匹配；验证工作按对齐后的要求进行，采购与合规评估据此展开。
statement.en: The decision rule is printed in the security-level sentence: "must be chosen to provide a level of security appropriate for the security requirements of the application and environment" Levels are not maximised but matched to the deployment, and validation proceeds against the aligned requirements, which is how procurement and compliance assessment read them.A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records.

statement.zh: 密码模块安全要求的broken见来源账本与正文其他节；该条目不以空段充数。
statement.en: Three limits follow from alignment itself.First, aligning is not identity: the sentence says aligns with and explicitly carries annex modifications, so validating against the national FIPS is not automatically clause-for-clause validation against the international edition.

statement.zh:
沿革句按留存件印出的两处版本关系复述：FIPS 140-3 取代 FIPS 140-2，并对齐 ISO/IEC 19790 的 2012 版（文件印作 ISO/IEC 19790:2012(E)），测试依据则点名 ISO/IEC 24759:2017(E)。FIPS 140-3 的发布月份按扉页为 2019 年 3 月，头部与获取信息按项目口径复述于引号外。这条时间线说明模块要求的国际版在先、本国第三版在后并对齐它，而不是反向。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：密码模块安全要求的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。
statement.en: The lineage is the two version relations printed in the front matter: FIPS 140-3 supersedes FIPS 140-2 and aligns with the 2012 international edition, printed as ISO/IEC 19790:2012(E), while testing is named against ISO/IEC 24759:2017(E).The cover dates FIPS 140-3 to March 2019; header and retrieval lines are restated outside quotes per house rule.
